location.description: City/state to combine with 'search'. Ignored if startUrls is provided.
location.title: Location (optional)

maxItems.description: Maximum number of job postings to return.
maxItems.title: Max Items

proxyConfiguration.description: ZipRecruiter blocks datacenter IPs; hardcoded to RESIDENTIAL US. Do not disable.
proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration

search.description: Alternative shortcut — keyword (e.g., 'nurse') combined with 'location' to build a default ZipRecruiter URL.
search.title: Search Keyword (optional)

startUrls.description: ZipRecruiter search URLs (e.g., https://www.ziprecruiter.com/jobs-search?search=software+engineer&location=New+York%2C+NY). Any filters applied in the URL are preserved.
startUrls.title: Start URLs
